visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit, minimalist studio with a marble-topped counter and a modern kitchen in the background. A man with short black hair, wearing a white sleeveless t-shirt and black trousers, stands facing the camera. He holds a black rectangular box with the word 'PEDRO' printed in silver. He smiles at the camera, gesturing with his hands as he talks. (2) He lifts the lid of the box, revealing white branded tissue paper. He reaches in and pulls out a chunky black leather loafer. The scene cuts briefly to a mirror selfie on a smartphone screen showing him sitting on a large bed with a grey headboard, wearing the same shoes and a white button-down shirt. (3) Back in the studio, a montage sequence begins. He appears in various outfits: first, a grey oversized blazer with black pants; next, a dark grey t-shirt with wide-leg blue denim jeans; then, a light grey short-sleeved button-up shirt with grey cargo pants and a black crossbody bag. Each shot emphasizes how the black loafers complement the different styles. (4) The camera focuses on a low black table where two pairs of shoes are placed next to a black handbag. He picks up a pair of 'Alto' loafers, showing the textured grain of the leather to the lens. He then wears them with white socks, performing a small dance step to show comfort. (5) He showcases 'Saxton' derby shoes, which have a brown-colored sole edge. He points to the side of the shoe. A cutaway shows him leaning against a counter in a different indoor setting. Finally, he sits on a white textured chair in the studio, holding one shoe up to explain the sole design while surrounded by the other featured footwear on the table.
